_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgXFRsfSS1tQB1kBxAZ86579)_

Fixes #35470

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: Bill, 2026-11-19 12:02Z, option A 「不归区,评测照质检办」 (ruling record 7008518427 on the card)
Changeset: none, labelled `skip-changeset` — the diff touches fleet rule text and two report-only scripts under `scripts/pm/`; no published package moves.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;变化只在车队内部的每日巡查里,专题卡不再被列为缺类型,质检与评测的运行记录不再被催着补区、补级。
- 为什么做:落实您刚定的「运行记录不归区、评测记录照质检记录办」,并补上分级规则改版后巡查仍在误报专题卡和运行记录的两处漏洞,分诊席不必再每天手工剔除。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是巡查少列一张本该补区或补类型的卡,只影响内部分诊、不碰产品;直接撤回这次合并即可恢复原状。
- 要你做什么:审阅北极星里新增的一句「运行记录不带区」,然后合并。

## What changes

| Row | Change |
|:--|:--|
| R1 | `eval-run` joins the first-touch sweep's exclusions: the rule sentence in `triage-duties.md` (wording kept in place, the pinned phrase in `TRIAGE_RULE_PHRASES` follows) and `EXCLUDED_LABELS` in `first-touch-sweep.mjs`, with its header sentence. |
| R2 | `eval-run` joins `H13_EXEMPT_LABELS` and `H74_EXEMPT_LABELS` in `check-half-states.mjs`; H74's finding text names it among the exempt carriers. |
| R3 | `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, Grading step one, one sentence after the record/epic type sentence: "A record card (`qa-run`, `eval-run`) takes no area either." Nothing else in the North Star moves. |
| R4 | `scenario-eval/SKILL.md` §5 loses the two stopgap lines that told the eval seat to close a record in the round it was filed, or else tell triage it is a record. Nothing else in the skill changes. |
| R5 | `first-touch-sweep.mjs`: the type row (`lacksType`) exempts `pm:epic` beside `tracking`. The area row and the five disjunctions are unchanged, and `pm:epic` is not added to `EXCLUDED_LABELS` (an epic still owes an area). The exemption's rule sentence in `triage-duties.md` is pinned as `TYPE_EXEMPT_PHRASE`. |
| R6 | `qa-run` and `eval-run` join `GRADELESS_CARD_LABELS`, so H78 is silent on an ungraded run record named in a `Blocked-by:` line. |

The run-record kinds are spelled once: `RUN_RECORD_LABELS = ['qa-run', 'eval-run']` in `check-half-states.mjs`, read by `EXCLUDED_LABELS`, `H13_EXEMPT_LABELS`, `H74_EXEMPT_LABELS` and `GRADELESS_CARD_LABELS`. A new record kind becomes one edit (the analysis's design note).

Read first, by risk:

1. `scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs`, the `lacksType` hunk: the only behaviour change on a row that is not about run records. It must not touch `lacksArea` or `classify`.
2. `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, the `RUN_RECORD_LABELS` hunk and its three readers.
3. `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`: the one sentence.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs --self-test` prints `✓ first-touch-sweep self-test: 67 cases pass across 6 batteries`.

### Live sweep delta

Read-only, the same board, a few seconds apart, at 2026-11-19 13:57Z (walk complete, 451 open issues, equal to the platform's count). `main`'s script against this branch's:

| Row | `main` | this branch | Removed |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| ① bare | #34842 | none | #34842 (the open `eval-run` record) |
| area row | #34842 | none | #34842 |
| type row | #27108, #27314, #31527, #34571, #34842, #35522 | #35522 | the four epic cards and #34842 |
| verdict | FOUND 3 card(s) owed a first touch | FOUND 2 | #34842 leaves the owed set |

Seven rows go. The rest are unchanged: ③ #34571, ⑤ #35518, and #35522 (a queued work card with no type) on the type row.

## Tests

Self-tests: one new case per R-row where a script changes. Each touched battery's floor equals its measured count.

- `first-touch-sweep.mjs --self-test`: 63 → 67 cases. R1 adds `eval-run` to the three exclusion rows and one case for an `eval-run` record alone (no disjunction, no area row, no type row). R5 adds three cases: the rule phrase pin; an epic draws no type row while a `pm:epic` card missing an area still draws the area row; `pm:epic` is not an exclusion. Floors: classifier 18 → 20 and backstop 14 → 17, both equal to their counts.
- `check-half-states.mjs --self-test`: 5356 → 5359 cases. R2 adds an H13 `eval-run` exemption case, an `eval-run` row in H74's exempt loop and the exact exempt-list pin. R6 adds an H78 case: a run record of either kind is silent. Floors: `H74 first-touch audit` 46 → 61 and `H77-H81 blocking relation read from the lines` 102 → 103, both equal to their counts.

<details><summary>Ablations, one per script (committed change, mutated through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to HEAD)</summary>

- `first-touch-sweep.mjs`: the `pm:epic` clause dropped from `lacksType`. Anchor 1 → 0, blob 954562d94ecc → 6b4eb438f899. Self-test exit 1, `1 of 67 case(s) failed` (the epic case: got `[true,true,true,false]`). Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `check-half-states.mjs`: `RUN_RECORD_LABELS` cut to `['qa-run']`. Anchor 1 → 0, blob 8333ed612af7 → 044c0f7266f6. half-states self-test exit 1, `4 of 5359` (H13 `eval-run`, H78 run record, H74 `eval-run` carrier, H74 exact list). The sweep self-test (it reads the same list) exit 1, `4 of 67` (the three exclusion rows and the `eval-run` case). Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

Both went red, as expected.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The live sweep lists #34571 (an open `pm:epic` card with an `area:*` and no other pm label) under ③ on both `main` and this branch. The sweep's ③ reads `PM_EXCLUSIVE_STATE_LABELS`, which leaves `pm:epic` out. H13 asks the same "area with no pm state" question through `PM_STATE_LABELS`, which counts `pm:epic`. This is out of this card's scope and unchanged here; it goes to the seat in the report.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exits 1 locally on `platform-core.seed-mode-matrix` (`SeedMode` read as 0 members). This diff touches neither of its inputs (`packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/`), and both are byte-identical to base `f727061b88`. The PR's own `Lint & Repo Gates` run is the reading for it.
- Ratchet: `check-skill-line-ratchet` is green. `triage-duties.md` stays at 108 lines (ceiling 108). `scenario-eval/SKILL.md` has no ratchet row, so no row moves.
